description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the 'Generator' class within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Confluence' namespace. It tests various aspects of the Confluence generator, including configuration validation, page creation, updating, deletion, attachment handling, and different setup scenarios.

classes.name: GeneratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the Confluence page generator within the Daux documentation framework, including configuration validation, tree generation, page publishing, updating, deletion, and handling attachments.

methods.name: configurationTestProvider
methods.description: Provides various invalid and valid configuration scenarios to test generator configuration validation logic.

methods.name: testConfiguration
methods.description: Tests validation of essential configuration parameters for the Confluence generator.

methods.name: initPublish
methods.description: Initializes the configuration for publishing with a virtual file system and returns a configured GlobalConfig object.

methods.name: runPublish
methods.description: Executes the publishing process with a given configuration and API mock, and captures the output messages.

methods.name: testPublishAllPages
methods.description: Verifies the creation and publishing of all pages in a typical hierarchical structure.

methods.name: testUpdatePublishedPages
methods.description: Ensures existing pages are correctly identified and updated without unnecessary modifications.

methods.name: testDeletePages
methods.description: Tests the deletion of obsolete pages when the 'delete' flag is set.

methods.name: testWarnAboutDelete
methods.description: Checks that pages are listed for deletion without actual deletion when delete is not enabled.

methods.name: testFindRootByAncestor
methods.description: Validates finding or creating the root page by ancestor ID.

methods.name: testCreateRootAndPublishAllPages
methods.description: Tests the creation of the root page when it does not exist and subsequent page publishing.

methods.name: testCreateRootWithSiblingSpaceAndPublishAllPages
methods.description: Verifies creation of a root page with sibling pages in a different space.

methods.name: testRootNotFound
methods.description: Ensures proper exception handling when the root page cannot be located or created.

methods.name: testRootNotFoundButFoundSiblings
methods.description: Checks exception handling when the root page is missing but siblings are found.

methods.name: testPublishAttachments
methods.description: Tests uploading attachments and embedding them correctly within pages.

methods.name: testMixed
methods.description: Validates a scenario involving updates, creation, deletions, and dry-run behavior with print_diff enabled.
